A '''heavy slugthrower pistol''' was a weapon that fired metal bullets called "[[Slug/Legends|slugs]]" instead of the energy bolts normally fired out of a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. It was larger and slightly more powerful version of the standard [[Slugthrower pistol/Legends|slugthrower pistol]]. Its increased power created more recoil, which made it more difficult to fire several shots in rapid succession accurately. Its larger size and loud firing could be used for intimidation if one encountered a group of unfriendly natives.<ref name="The Unknown Regions" />

In the [[Coreesh Mountains]] located on the distant [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Veroleem]], a Master Cult Adept of the [[Cult of Veroleem]] was equipped with this weapon while he was overseeing the "processing" of a group of prisoners that would force them into becoming new cult members. He was intercepted by a rescue party that rescued the prisoners at the Temple of Veroleem.<ref name="Lost Souls">{{WizCite|book=The Unknown Regions|story=The Finding of Lost Souls}}</ref>
